## Gerrit change 2354 — "Make the lean discovery row actually lean"

`https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2354`. NOT submitted.

Split out of Gerrit 2336, which carried both halves of the `daughterly-agitative-ocelot` fix
and could not pass plan review: its AC-2 had to argue one shared projection, two backends, an
untouched library, an MCP-layer application point, three narrowing surfaces and three
unaffected consumers inside a single bullet, at 7,678 of the 8,000-char admission cap. 2336 is
marked WIP with a supersession note.

### What landed

`LEAN_OMITTED_FIELDS` + `lean_projection` in `_engine_support/reads.py` are the one spelling of
the lean row, dropping `authorship_ledger`/`attestations`/`signature`/`keyring` as well as the
two bodies. `_snapshot/ticket_view.py` calls the same function. `ready_tickets` gains
`full: bool = False` and projects through it via `_discovery_rows`. The golden-path probe's
show-vs-list drift assertion is repaired and now DERIVES its expectation. Breaking-change notes
for the three narrowing surfaces in `docs/release-notes.md` + `CHANGELOG.md`.

### Blast radius, re-verified from source

Six consumers reach the lean path; **three narrow**, and the narrowing comes from each
CALLER's own flag default, never the library's:

- CLI `rebar list` — `"include_body": ns.full` (`reads_cli.py:286`), `--full` defaults False.
- MCP `list_tickets` — its own `full: bool = False` (`_mcp_reads.py:291`).
- MCP `ready_tickets` — new here.

**Unaffected:** the LIBRARY `rebar.list_tickets`, whose own `full` defaults **True**
(`_lib_reads.py:128`) — a direct library call still returns the full shape; `validate.py:67`
(2,863 rows, `query=None` -> default `TicketQuery()`); `next_batch.py:144` (62 rows,
`include_body` unset). `show_state` / `search_state` never call `list_states` at all.

The plan-review gate BLOCKED an earlier revision for getting exactly this wrong — the first
draft claimed the library default narrows. It does not. Corrected before the review passed.

### Verification

- Backend parity tested against a real pinned view, both directions (parity + `include_body=True`
  still carries the bodies), using a parent-bounded query because `list_by_query` raises
  `UnsupportedPinnedQuery` on a parentless one.
- Both discovery surfaces asserted to agree on their default key set.
- Mutation check: shrinking `LEAN_OMITTED_FIELDS` back to the two body fields turns 3 shape
  tests RED and the golden-path probe from 142/0 to 141/1.
- `make lint` (ratchet `active=39 new=0 increased=0`), `make typecheck` (685 files),
  `pytest tests/unit tests/interfaces` 7,747 passed, `probe_rebar.py` 142/0.

### Attestation

Plan review PASSED and signed at `25ea12c2`. It has since gone `stale-code` because
`CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/release-notes.md` moved on `origin/main` (unrelated entries from other
changes landing) — the claim it authorised already happened, and change 2354 earned
`LLM-Review +1` on patch set 1.
